name: Vegas Casino Environment
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'set -e; chmod +x .devcontainer/post_create.sh && chmod +x codespace/configuration/init.sh && chmod +x codespace/deployment.sh && echo "Running post_create.sh..." && .devcontainer/post_create.sh && echo "Running init.sh..." && codespace/configuration/init.sh && echo "Running deployment.sh..." && codespace/deployment.sh'

DT_TENANT.description: Dynatrace tenant base URL, e.g. https://abc12345.live.dynatrace.com.

DT_OPERATOR_TOKEN.description: Dynatrace PLATFORM token (dt0s16), operator scopes: fleet-management:{activegate.connection-info:read, activegate.tokens:create, container-images:read, oneagent.connection-info:read, oneagents:download}, settings:objects:{read,write}.

DT_INGEST_TOKEN.description: Dynatrace PLATFORM token (dt0s16), data ingest: openpipeline:{traces,metrics,logs,events}:ingest + storage:metrics:write.

PARTICIPANT_ID.description: Your unique DNS-label-safe id; names kind cluster, k8s.cluster.name, DynaKube.

WORKSHOP_DISPENSER_URL.description: LiteLLM dispenser URL (advanced track / opencode) — from facilitator.

WORKSHOP_ROOM_PASSWORD.description: LiteLLM dispenser room password (advanced track) — from facilitator.
